title: The algorithm doc, the products doc and the two posture files fall back to an empty string when missing
evidence: app/lib/chat.server.ts reads health_roadmap_algorithm.md (about :56-62), docs/products.md (about :70-77) and chat-posture-doctor.md / chat-posture-brand.md (the posture loader, about :177-183) at import; each catch logs a console.warn and sets ''. No Sentry message, and chat keeps answering without that text. An empty file sets '' with no warning. T28 (US-15 AC65) made the base system prompt one state that refuses chat on missing; these four were left as they are. loadSharedDoc (about :85-92) is the precedent that at least reports to Sentry.
